description: List all lists in the account. Returns {data:[...],paging:{...}} — each list's id, name, contact counts by status, and created_at. Paginate with `limit` (max 100) and `starting_after` (cursor from the previous page). EmailOctopus: GET /lists.

starting_after.description: Pagination cursor — the id to start after (from the previous page's paging).

name: emailoctopus_list_lists
title: List lists
